svg.title: Night Shift — five stops, one delivery
svg.desc: An original black-and-yellow freight wagon crosses a neon night city. Five mechanical arms load five cubes at five stops. At a larger dispatch terminal, bottom gates open and the cubes drop onto a conveyor. The empty wagon continues into a new sprint. A 36-second repeating decorative scene, not live GitHub statistics. Reduced motion shows a still scene.

g.text: สวัสดีครับ
สวัสดีครับ
A LITTLE PROGRESS AT EVERY STOP.
